records.description_rewritten: Freizeitbad Düsselstrand is a real operating municipal family water park at Kettwiger Straße 50, Düsseldorf-Flingern. The old gay-szene listing claims activity in changing/shower rooms, but the latest visible dated comments are February 2017, including one describing a sauna renovation and claiming meetings sometimes still happened. The pool's official November 2026 schedule confirms public swimming hours, school/group arrangements and supervised family facilities—not cruising or permission for sexual activity.

supplemental_evidence.note: Official operating pool at Kettwiger Str. 50 with children/family facilities and timetable; operating is not cruising verification.
Standard weekday 09:00-22:00, weekends 08:00-20:00 as of Nov 2026; time subject to holidays.

older_evidence.note: Describes 2017 renovation and claimed continued discreet activity, not current.

records.access_information: Paid public family pool and communal changing/shower rooms subject to staff supervision and bath house rules; privacy and consent essential. Not a dedicated darkroom.

records.description_rewritten: Baggersee am Hart is the Dietersheimer Weiher/Alter Echinger See, east of Eching near the Garchinger Heide nature reserve. Gays-Cruising lists it as a gay cruising lead, and historic 2019 naturist visitors describe secluded sunbathing; those naturist reports do not establish actual sex activity. Freising district tourism identifies a parking point near Dietersheimer Straße, and warns visitors to keep to marked paths in adjacent protected Garchinger Heide. Do NOT conflate with the newer Echinger See or assume the old pond is safe for swimming.

supplemental_evidence.note: District describes adjacent protected Garchinger Heide, path-only access and Parkplatz Baggersee am Hart.
February 2019 visit about Alter Echinger Weiher, not a cruising encounter.

records.description_rewritten: The Gays-Cruising source labels an FKK area along the old Rhine near Efringen-Kirchen. An independent 2018 French cruising directory describes informal gay naturist and cruising along riverbanks downstream of Isteiner Schwellen, but does not establish activity within 12 months. A distinct Efringen-Kirchen car park/woodland has a 25 June 2026 positive visitor post and was the focus of a January 2025 closure proposal. It is not yet proven the riverside FKK lead is the same spot as that car park, so do not import its 2026 report automatically.

supplemental_evidence.note: 2018 named Rhône? Actually Rhine bank: French entry describes riverside naturist/cruising location, historical.
Nearby parking proposal to close due to cruising, may be related but not proof this exact FKK river subsite.

older_evidence.note: French directory entry, no verified recent site visit.

records.access_information: Rhine shoreline and floodplain may be protected; road/rail embankments, water currents and private plots are hazards. No right to enter through fences or assume swimming is safe.

records.description_rewritten: 'Sortie Efringen' is a French-language label meaning the A5 Efringen-Kirchen motorway exit, with an associated parking spot and woodland. The original country directory has no detailed 2026 account, but gay-szene.net's separate Parkplatz Efringen-Kirchen entry and Croozr's historic guide likely refer to the same exit-adjacent car park. The 25 June 2026 gay-szene first-person positive report is recent evidence for the EXIT PARKING lead, although the source was originally grouped under Lörrach/Kleinkems and exact identity with this generic Gays-Cruising record remains provisional. A local council requested car park closure in January 2025 and a July 2025 visitor reported a construction fence; current reopening needs verification.

supplemental_evidence.note: 25 June 2026 first-person positive scene report; July 2025 closure/fence claim, not independent 2026 physical access.

records.description_rewritten: Parkplatz Efringen-Kirchen is the A5 exit-side car park near Kleinkems and a wooded Rhine floodplain. The original gay-szene forum has a 25 June 2026 positive, firsthand report of men meeting there, older spring 2025 reports of activity, and a 1 July 2025 firsthand observation that fencing blocked vehicle access. A January 2025 report documented the local council asking authorities to close the car park due to litter and cruising; that was a proposal, not confirmed permanent closure. Today's specific parking/woods access needs careful verification; June 2026 visitor activity alone does not prove legal entry to a fenced site.

supplemental_evidence.note: Jan 21 2025 local council request closure due to sex cruising/litter; decision not independently confirmed.
